description: This file defines enumerations and related helper methods for various loan-related configuration options within the Fineract system. It provides mappings from internal enum values to user-friendly display data, distinguishes different types of frequencies, interest methods, loan statuses, and other loan parameters, facilitating consistent representation across the application.

classes.name: LoanEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing enumeration mappings and helper methods for loan attributes.

methods.name: loanEnumeration
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData based on type name and id, facilitates dynamic enumeration retrieval.

methods.name: repaymentStartDateType
methods.description: Creates EnumOptionData for repayment start date type given an int or enum.

methods.name: loanTermFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps period frequency type to display data for loan term frequency options.

methods.name: termFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps period frequency type to display data for term frequency options.

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps period frequency type to display data for repayment frequency options.

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyNthDayType
methods.description: Creates EnumOptionData for ordinal position of repayment frequency (e.g., first, second).

methods.name: repaymentFrequencyDayOfWeekType
methods.description: Creates EnumOptionData for day of the week for repayment frequency.

methods.name: interestRateFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps period frequency type to interest rate frequency display data.

methods.name: amortizationType
methods.description: Maps amortization method to user-friendly description data.

methods.name: interestType
methods.description: Maps interest calculation method to display data.

methods.name: interestCalculationPeriodType
methods.description: Maps interest calculation period method to display data.

methods.name: transactionType
methods.description: Maps loan transaction type to detailed data for external representation.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Provides display data for different loan statuses.

methods.name: loanCycleValueConditionType
methods.description: Maps loan cycle value condition type to display data.

methods.name: loanCycleParamType
methods.description: Maps loan cycle parameter type to display data.

methods.name: loanVariationType
methods.description: Maps loan term variation type to display data.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingType
methods.description: Maps interest recalculation compounding methods to display data.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingNthDayType
methods.description: Creates display data for nth day type in interest recalculation context.

methods.name: interestRecalculationCompoundingDayOfWeekType
methods.description: Displays day of week type for interest recalculation.

methods.name: rescheduleStrategyType
methods.description: Maps rescheduling strategies for loans.

methods.name: interestRecalculationFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps recalculation frequency enums to display data.

methods.name: preCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
methods.description: Returns strategy options for pre-close interest calculation.
